definitions: To experience a difficult or unpleasant situation.
To examine something carefully, often in a detailed way.
To be officially approved or completed.
To use up or spend all of something.
examples: She's going through a tough time at work.
Let's go through the report page by page.
The new law went through Parliament last week.
We went through all our savings on that holiday.
They went through the presentation one last time.
